latin: Post intellectualem ebdomadem ordinandi sunt immediate supermundani dei a partibus uniuersi exempti, et incoordinabiles ad hunc mundum, et secundum causam eum undique circumplectentes.
translation: After the intellectual hebdomad, the supermundane gods must be ranked immediately -- exempt from the parts of the universe, not coordinate with this world, and embracing it on every side according to causation.
